worldcombat.skill.wideguard.summary: Throws up a wide light wall around the user, peeling whole ranged and area attacks off nearby allies. It stands for only a moment, wears through after a few hits, and contact melee passes straight through.
worldcombat.skill.wideguard.use.0: Block a volley of ranged attacks coming in
worldcombat.skill.wideguard.use.1: Raise the wall a beat before allies are caught by an area move
worldcombat.skill.wideguard.use.2: Eat one burst for the team in a short window
The wide wall absorbs about %1$s non-contact damage per ally and stands for about %2$s s.
At the moment it is raised, it covers the user and allies within %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.wideguard.brace.wide: Wide wall: larger radius but wears faster; it covers more.
worldcombat.skill.wideguard.brace.dense: Dense wall: more absorption and a smaller radius; it holds tighter.
worldcombat.skill.wideguard.timing: Self move: after %1$s s of preparation it costs %3$s PP, then %2$s s of recovery and a %4$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.wideguard.preference.b: Wide wall: cover radius x1.25, absorption x0.8. Dense wall: absorption x1.25, radius x0.85. Each has its own opening.
worldcombat.skill.wideguard.preference.a: Consider raising the wall when a threat is within this distance; larger predicts earlier but wastes more walls.
When on, the wall is only raised while another ally is inside the alert radius; when off, pressure on the user is enough.
It turns aside only ranged and area attacks from enemies; point-blank melee passes through. The caster and each covered ally carry a separate pool that ends when spent or when the window expires, and damage beyond the remaining pool lands as usual. The wall also drops for an ally that moves too far from the caster or loses line of sight.
